$comment: L2H-06: real-keyboard shortcut contracts. Keys are driven through page.keyboard in contract-runner (fresh page each). Passing rows assert real DOM/status/event effects; xfail rows document honest gaps (headless clipboard, native-only ops, confirm-gated close, deletion has no absence-assert vocabulary).

assertion.note: Ctrl+Alt+1 wraps the selection block in H1 via emitCommand('formatBlock','H1') (editor.js ~11078); the list fixture starts with zero headings, so the first #editor h1 appearing is the chord's effect
Ctrl+Alt+2 wraps the block in H2 (editor.js ~11078)
Ctrl+Alt+3 wraps the block in H3 (editor.js ~11078)
copyFormat captures paintedFormat + setStatus(Status.FormatCopied) (editor.js ~11047, i18n.js:855 'Format copied — select target text and press Ctrl+Alt+V'); boot status is 'Ready'
pasteFormat with paintedFormat=null on a fresh page sets Status.NoFormatToPaste (editor.js ~11048, i18n.js:866 'Copy a format first (Ctrl+Alt+C)')
Ctrl+Minus (ev.code Minus, !shift !alt) emits insertSymbol U+2013 at the caret (editor.js ~10990); the default doc contains no en-dash

Shift+Enter is not intercepted by editor.js; native contentEditable inserts
at the caret; the default doc has zero br
F9 runs fieldOpAtSelection('update') which always dispatches the wo:field-op window CustomEvent (editor.js ~11061); contract-runner arms a window listener for it

Ctrl+Alt+F runs openBackstage('open') (editor.js ~11029): #backstage-overlay (.open -> display:flex, style.css:2520) switches from display:none to flex — same observable as the proven closemenu contract inverted

shortcut.paste.note: trusted CDP key chord + seedClipboard: the native paste path inserts the seeded system clipboard text

shortcut.pastetextwithoutformat.note: Ctrl+Shift+V is not bound in editor.js (the text-only paste chord is Ctrl+T, ~11242); the chord reaches the browser default paste which is a no-op with an empty headless clipboard

shortcut.copy.note: no keydown binding — the browser default copies the placeCaret selection to the (permissioned) system clipboard; non-empty clipboard assertion

shortcut.cut.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-06: native clipboard cut shrinks the placeCaret selection; text-mutation lacks pins the shrink (copied clipboard content is not observable headless, but the deletion effect is)

shortcut.deleteleftchar.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-06: the interception only handles strokes/objects; plain text falls to native deletion of the placeCaret 4-char selection ('Will' from the fixture h1) — text-mutation now has a lacks assertion to pin the shrink

shortcut.deleterightchar.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-06: same native-selection deletion path as Backspace, now observable via text-mutation lacks

shortcut.closefile.note: acceptDialogs accepts the dirty-close window.confirm Playwright otherwise auto-dismisses; the close dispatches wo:close-document
